plan.objective: Fix username field editing issue in UserModal component

root_cause.finding: The username field in UserModal is missing explicit disabled={false} prop
Other editable fields (email, password) have both readonly={false} and disabled={false}
The Input component may be defaulting disabled state incorrectly for username field

task.description: Add explicit disabled={false} prop to username Input field
task.change: Add disabled={false} prop to match email and password fields

task.description: Verify the fix by testing the user edit modal

steps.step: Check that username field is now editable
Verify no visual artifacts or errors
Test saving changes with modified username

tests.test: Username field should be editable when editing user
Username field should not be disabled or readonly
Username changes should be saved correctly

task.content: Document the fix for username field editability issue
